pool: 2025-published CVEs; publication-month end; exclude prior KEV from catalog or snapshot flag
label: KEV date_added after snapshot month and through 2025-12-31; non-KEV is unobserved, not proven safe

selection.rule: Mean recall across literal and equal-workload budgets in two forward 2025 evaluations; within 1/55 prefer simpler
selection.warning: Development comparisons; test-year model selection is optimistic. H2 overlaps the primary test.

scaling.note: Literal 500 is also shown. Monthly budgets partition 500 by cohort size; not 500 per month.

censoring.note: Primary includes censored late rows for seed comparability; mature and fixed-90-day results are separate. December has zero follow-up.

uncertainty.method: paired month bootstrap; equal-workload budget; fixed fitted models
uncertainty.limitation: Only 12 months; does not include model selection or retraining uncertainty.

tie_break: Descending score, then cve_id ascending; CVSS baseline uses current scores only for benchmark reference
baseline_caveat: Current CVSS is an explicitly unsafe reference, never a strict production feature.

exact_calendar_analog.name: exact_calendar_analog_2025
exact_calendar_analog.snapshot_rule: Published January–September; publication-month end except June shifted to July
exact_calendar_analog.note: Matches the benchmark calendar shape and November 4 endpoint. Training still requires 90 days follow-up.
